phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.reason: Phase-1 acceptance remains unresolved and a new physical-pool integrity blocker is now explicit: the repository-required 14-role pool has only 13 physically runnable required roles. The missing required novelty role remains logically enabled and assigned in repository control, so silently shrinking the denominator would violate non-regression and full-pool policy.

actual_execution_authority.assignment_reason: Preserve every existing Phase-1 assignment and base/restoration continuation. Keep all currently runnable required roles on Phase-1 work; do not use a physical schedule disappearance to restore base work or reduce the acceptance pool.

physical_scheduler_repository_divergence.observation: Platform observation shows the repository-required o_novelty_comparator scheduled role is not physically active, while O_CHAT_PARALLEL control6 and DOWNSTREAM_STATE control29 still logically require and assign p1-dedup-mechanisms with enabled_desired=true.
physical_scheduler_repository_divergence.classification: user-only physical scheduler blocker for the 14-role Phase-1 acceptance baseline; repository mutation alone cannot restore platform execution
physical_scheduler_repository_divergence.impact: Phase-1 root closure and Phase-2 transition are fail-closed until physical availability is restored or the user explicitly changes the topology requirement. Remaining runnable workers continue Phase-1 work.

aggregate_checker_status.observation: evidence_comparator config13 bootstrapped validly, independently rederived the known duplicate-effect negative-control failure, and correctly left checker-v2 usefulness controls not_assessed because current evaluation state had not yet materialized checker-v2/control-family evidence. This is fail-closed behavior, not a comparator defect.

clean_role_progress.failure_evidence: Fresh Phase-1 receipt added scoped fencing/pointer counterexamples and preserved CLEAN isolation; post-scan head drift caused a correct checkpoint rather than stale continuation.
clean_role_progress.open_source: Recent durable commits show continued Phase-1 capability/policy verification progress.

changes_this_run.reason: Add an optimizer-side authoritative physical-availability gate without modifying any platform schedule, role assignment, enabled_desired state, CLEAN boundary, primary O state, or protected recovery behavior.

critical_path: Keep all 13 currently runnable required roles on non-conflicting Phase-1 leaves; completed/blocked workers remain under Phase-1 optimizer control and are not blanket-restored to base work.
Do not count o_novelty_comparator as a current physical-execution proof cell while its required schedule is unavailable, and do not lower the required 14-role denominator to bypass the blocker.
Await an explicit user-authorized physical scheduler restoration for o_novelty_comparator, then independently re-observe platform state before clearing the integrity gate.
In parallel, require evaluation checker-v2 durable precommit-before-execution and the duplicate negative, low-usefulness negative, and matched positive controls.
Require evidence_comparator config13 independent recomputation after checker-v2 artifacts exist.
Continue current clean/audit/bridge/human-monitor Phase-1 assignments and preserve exact continuation/evidence while the physical blocker is outstanding.
method_plan.forecast_change_reason: A new transversal physical-pool integrity leaf was discovered above the prior 21-node forecast.

alternative_plan_comparison.silent_shrink_to_13: rejected: would weaken the existing full-pool acceptance baseline and reward a scheduler disappearance
alternative_plan_comparison.repository_enabled_desired_false: rejected: explicitly forbidden optimization mechanism and would not repair physical execution
alternative_plan_comparison.preserve_14_and_fail_closed_while_13_con: selected: maintains non-regression, keeps available workers useful, and isolates the irreducible user-only scheduler action

contamination_audit.action_required_reason: Physical scheduler restoration for the missing required novelty role needs explicit user authorization or user action; repository control cannot perform it.

rollback.condition: When independent platform observation proves o_novelty_comparator physically runnable again, increment PHYSICAL_SCHEDULER_STATE and set the gate true. Never roll back by lowering required role count, logically disabling the role, creating a replacement worker, or claiming a repository write changed platform state.

termination.reason: One required physical proof cell is user-action blocked, but the remaining runnable pool has substantial independent Phase-1 work and is continuing.

exact_next_action: Re-observe platform physical state on the next optimizer run; if o_novelty_comparator remains unavailable, retain the fail-closed 14-role acceptance denominator and keep the 13 runnable roles on Phase-1 leaves.

If the user explicitly authorizes physical restoration, re-enable/restore only the required novelty schedule through the platform control plane, then verify it is physically active before clearing the gate; do not infer scheduler change from repository state.
Validate the first evaluation invocation that truly freezes DESIRED_STATE control20 and require durable checker-v2 precommit-before-execution plus all three aggregate controls.
Validate evidence_comparator config13 rederivation after checker-v2 artifacts exist.
Continue exact proof-cell reconciliation and do not enter Phase 2 until physical pool integrity, all required role cells, and aggregate hard gates are durably proven.
